extension.summary: Sync your Silo movies and TV shows into the Kodi library
extension.description: KodiConnectForSilo writes the movies and TV shows on your Silo server into Kodi's own video library, so every skin, widget and library feature treats them like local media. Watched state and resume points stay in step both ways, and playback streams from Silo: the original file when Kodi can play it, a converted stream otherwise. Community project: not made or endorsed by the Silo team.
extension.disclaimer: Do not run Kodi's "Clean library" on Silo items; KodiConnectForSilo manages them itself.
extension.news:
0.21.4: resolution and HDR chosen at sign-in, libraries and Top 10 rows chosen in the settings no longer revert when the settings screen closes. A row slower than a second logs where the time went (Silo or Kodi's library).
0.21.3: Dolby Vision badges name the profile (DOLBY VISION 7.6, 8.1), films and episodes, filled in automatically after updating. Safer when power is cut (smart plug schedules): no sign-out, a damaged record rebuilt. New pictures no longer reload every row.
0.21.2: the screensaver shows each title's logo (it was placed below the screen) and the whole background (it showed cropped). It starts on black and shows each background with its logo together, never the home screen.
0.21.1: switching to or from 4K menus clears Silo's pictures from Kodi's cache by itself (no files to delete). A show's logo no longer stays blank when Kodi asks for all its pictures at once. The screensaver no longer flashes the home screen between 4K pictures.
0.21.0: sharper pictures when Kodi draws its menus at 4K (CoreELEC p3i T5 and others): full-size backgrounds and title logos from Silo. With 4K menus, raise Kodi's own picture sizes too (advancedsettings.xml imageres 1440, fanartres 2160).
0.20.0: subtitles follow your Silo profile's settings (language, Auto/Always/Off, show forced subtitles), as Silo's apps do: English audio with foreign scenes shows the English forced track. Subtitle files from Silo show their language in Kodi.
